newsitem.title: USA: Pa. 614 MW Homer City coal unit 2 to restart today.
newsitem.headline: Pa. 614 MW Homer City coal unit 2 to restart today.

text.p: A 614 megawatt (MW) unit at the coal-fired generating complex in Homer City, Pa., was expected to resume operation today after being shut Thursday due to a turbine control problem, the operator said.
"It's scheduled to be up midday" said a spokeswoman for GPU Generation Inc.
The adjoining 620 MW unit 1 and 650 MW unit 3 were running at full output, the spokeswoman added.
Pennsylvania Electric Co (Penelec) and New York State Electric & Gas Corp each have a 50 percent interest in the Homer City units.
Both Penelec and GPU Generation are subsidiaries of GPU Inc of Parsippany, N.J.
The three Homer City units represent 11 percent of GPU Inc's total generating capacity.
